Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Cease Fire!]]: the battle droid commander OOM-9 on a Trade Federation tank in ''Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace'' (1999), waving his arm as he orders "Cease fire!" while the tanks' shells are still bursting on the Gungan army's energy shield. Reduced to 1000 by 425 pixels.

Source: a frame at 0:03 of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bjCLlsOvKrQ Star Wars: The Phantom Menace (1999) - "Activate the Droids" scene &#91;1080p&#93;], Screen Themes, YouTube (31 January 2022), a clip of the film directed by George Lucas, Lucasfilm and 20th Century Fox. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027132023/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bjCLlsOvKrQ Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced frame from the film, showing the order the card is named after, the work the card refers to. It is used only to identify that scene beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
